protocol.inputRecipe: Generated manifests retain one selected case and the same fontPrograms from the committed workload manifests; manifest and catalog bytes are embedded verbatim, with their hashes. Their relative paths resolve when materialized five directory levels below repository root. Process mode loads only fonts listed by the selected case; geometry uses none.

idle-before.txt: r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st gu
idle-after.txt: r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st gu

scope: No BenchmarkDotNet dependency or warmed-throughput claim. Fresh processes with warm OS caches; ready includes bootstrap, selected input/font I/O, validation and acquisition. Ping round trips include scheduling/protocol/flush; read/write call timers are buffered and contain no fsync. Instrumented arm has no latency result. Native counts attribute immediate-caller requests to the actual runtime compression module and track frees; they exclude allocator overhead, managed heaps and all other native modules. OS maxRSS is whole-process and is never subtracted from GC/heap estimates. Native charts include embedded-PNG decoding before output encoding.
interpretation: The six uninstrumented document/runtime cells each retain three launches, with 20 pipe round trips per launch. These are descriptive observations on one VM, not a before/after speed comparison or broad confidence interval.

Launch-to-ready medians range from 43.502 to 75.188 ms, buffered-read medians from 0.550 to 1.073 ms, pipe roundtrip medians from 13.360 to 13.911 us, and buffered-write medians from 0.220 to 0.362 ms. First conversion includes fresh-process JIT and renderer initialization, unlike warmed throughput.

Each of two PNG encodes requests 112 bytes of compression PAL state and 350336 bytes of aligned workspace, released before the next conversion. Font-free geometry and icon-sheet total 700896 requested bytes per two conversions; the chart also decodes its embedded PNG twice, adding 84576 requested bytes. All observed peaks are 350448 bytes with zero live tracked requests at process exit.

This closes the bounded minimal-consumer stage and positively attributed compression-request observations in P6. It does not account for every native module or allocator overhead, equate RSS with native storage, or establish a general performance improvement.
